declared_exclusions.reason: that API evaluates IDENTITY policies only and cannot see a resource-based KMS key policy, so it returned implicitDeny for kms:Decrypt -- which the key policy grants unconditionally -- and for a nonsensical action name. It is a non-discriminating instrument here, so it is recorded as an exclusion rather than dressed up as a control: the schema rightly treats a DID-NOT-DISCRIMINATE control as invalidating. The grant was proved by the key-policy read plus the one-object bucket-key write.
